claim: Readings of root's recognition records and of each take's own level envelope, bound to the hashes below. Every proposal has `by: null`: the bridge refuses it until root decides and signs it. Nothing here was heard, decoded, measured by ear or accepted.
envelope_rule: A pause is a run of at least 0.06 s of 5 ms frames at or below -70 dBFS. A point is assessed only when such a pause lies wholly after the start of the previous recognized word and ends by the point's own segment end. The pause used is the last of those that began by the recognizer start, so the sound after it can only be this word (or a breath before it). 'leave' is that pause's end. 'body' is the first frame at or above -30 dBFS after leave, where the word is clearly sounding. inside_word: the recognizer start is more than 0.03 s after body, so a boundary there puts the first part of the word in the sentence before; late_by_s = start - body is a lower bound. at_onset: within (leave, body + 0.03]. in_pause: at or before leave. before_pause: no such pause began by the start, and the start lies more than 0.03 s before the first one in the window, in sound that precedes it. not_assessed: no such pause (connected speech, or the previous word starts inside the pause).
